upstream.candidate_semantics: V8 beam8 fallback followed by V13 top-10 ranked-mask projections, stable descending 0.90 logit rank and V8 relative order
upstream.holdout: 581 B2B lineage-clean queries; no read during C0 or train-only C1

split.scope: only B2B clean-train source; no B2B inner-validation or 581-query holdout

candidate_budget.reason: same deployable top-1 budget for top4 and top10; pool oracle coverage is a separate ceiling

feature_schema: frozen V13 packet and query embeddings
all five frozen V13 retrieval logits

model.architecture: shared candidate MLP 128 hidden then one 4-head self-attention layer across candidate set, scalar output per candidate
model.duplicate_projection_rule: masks projecting to an identical full V8 order keep only the earliest-ranked candidate; later duplicate slots are masked in attention, loss and top1 inference
model.deployment: argmax selector score; lowest candidate rank breaks ties

optimization.loss: negative log probability mass of all candidates with an exact 0.90-successful prefix; examples with no successful candidate excluded from gradient but included in evaluation
optimization.selection_rule: maximum selector-validation top-1 0.90 success, then Complete, then lower mean penalized 0.90 token fraction, then earliest step

train_only_gate.penalized_cost: earliest 0.90 token fraction when successful; 1.0 when not successful
train_only_gate.failure_policy: STOP_SEL_C1_TRAIN_ONLY_GATE; do not evaluate 581 B2B holdout

holdout_policy_after_train_gate: Freeze model, checkpoint, features, top1 decision and metrics; then exactly one 581-query evaluation. This holdout is design-exposed because B2B selected top10; it is not confirmation.
